name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.02: Yokohama-kou Renzoku Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.02 横浜港連続殺人事件
source:
A mysterious man has been searching for his missing fiancée in Depono and has asked Detective Jake Hunter for help. As he investigates deeper he finds out that the case is much more sophisticated than it looks. 

[From [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#2]Pixelmenu[/url]]
translation:
一名神秘男子一直在德波诺寻找失踪的未婚妻，并向侦探神宫寺三郎求助。随着调查深入，神宫寺发现这起案件远比表面看起来更加错综复杂。

[摘自[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#2]Pixelmenu[/url]]
